cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_shots_attempted FROM nba.shot_detail
cases.summary: Counts all field goal attempts (made and missed) recorded in nba.shot_detail, which covers the 2023-24 regular season only. Note: this excludes free throws, which are not shots in this dataset's terminology.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT game_id) AS games_covered FROM nba.pbp_event;
cases.summary: Counts the distinct game_id values in the play-by-play table, which covers all 2023-24 regular season games loaded in this dataset.

cases.sql: SELECT shot_zone_basic, COUNT(*) AS attempts FROM nba.shot_detail GROUP BY shot_zone_basic ORDER BY attempts DESC LIMIT 1;
cases.summary: Finds the shot zone (shot_zone_basic) with the most field goal attempts (makes and misses combined) in the 2023-24 regular season data.

cases.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS made_threes
FROM nba.shot_detail
WHERE shot_type = '3PT Field Goal'
  AND shot_made_flag = 1
cases.summary: Counts all made three-point field goals in the 2023-24 regular season (the only season loaded) from shot_detail.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS shot_attempts FROM nba.shot_detail WHERE player_name = 'Stephen Curry'
cases.summary: Counts all field goal attempts (made and missed) by Stephen Curry in shot_detail for the 2023-24 regular season (the only season loaded). Note this excludes free throws, which aren't shot attempts anyway.

cases.sql: SELECT player_name, COUNT(*) AS field_goal_attempts FROM nba.shot_detail GROUP BY player_name ORDER BY field_goal_attempts DESC LIMIT 10
cases.summary: Counts field goal attempts (made + missed shots) per player in nba.shot_detail for the 2023-24 regular season and returns the top 10 by attempt count. Note this covers field goal attempts only, not free throws.

cases.sql: SELECT shot_zone_basic, COUNT(*) AS attempts, SUM(shot_made_flag) AS makes, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(shot_made_flag) / COUNT(*), 1) AS fg_pct FROM nba.shot_detail WHERE player_name = 'Nikola Jokic' AND season = 2023 AND season_type = 'regular' GROUP BY shot_zone_basic ORDER BY attempts DESC
cases.summary: Field goal percentage by shot zone for Nikola Jokic in the 2023-24 regular season (the only season loaded), computed from shot_detail as made shots / total attempts per shot_zone_basic, including attempt counts for context.

cases.sql:
SELECT team_name, COUNT(*) AS three_point_attempts
FROM nba.shot_detail
WHERE shot_type = '3PT Field Goal'
GROUP BY team_name
ORDER BY three_point_attempts DESC
LIMIT 1;
cases.summary: Counts all 3PT Field Goal attempts (made and missed) in shot_detail grouped by team, returning the team with the most attempts.

cases.sql:
SELECT period, COUNT(*) AS shot_attempts
FROM nba.shot_detail
GROUP BY period
ORDER BY period;
cases.summary: Counts field goal attempts (makes and misses, from shot_detail) grouped by period for the loaded 2023-24 regular season.

cases.sql: SELECT player_name, COUNT(*) AS three_pt_attempts, SUM(shot_made_flag) AS three_pt_makes, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(shot_made_flag) / COUNT(*), 1) AS three_pt_pct FROM nba.shot_detail WHERE shot_type = '3PT Field Goal' GROUP BY player_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 200 ORDER BY three_pt_pct DESC LIMIT 10
cases.summary: Ranks players by 3PT field goal percentage in the 2023-24 regular season (only season loaded), restricted to players with at least 200 three-point attempts, showing makes/attempts alongside the percentage.

cases.sql: SELECT player_name, team_name, game_date, shot_distance, shot_type, action_type FROM nba.shot_detail WHERE season = 2023 AND season_type = 'regular' AND shot_made_flag = 1 ORDER BY shot_distance DESC LIMIT 1
cases.summary: Finds the made field goal with the greatest shot_distance in the 2023-24 regular season (the only season loaded).

cases.sql: SELECT player2_name AS player, COUNT(*) AS assists FROM nba.pbp_event WHERE eventmsgtype = 1 AND player2_id IS NOT NULL AND player2_id != 0 GROUP BY player2_name ORDER BY assists DESC LIMIT 10
cases.summary: Counts assists as player2 on made field goals (eventmsgtype = 1) in pbp_event, since assists exist only there; returns the top 10 players by assist count for the loaded 2023-24 regular season.

cases.sql: SELECT player1_name AS player, COUNT(*) AS turnovers FROM nba.pbp_event WHERE eventmsgtype = 5 AND season = 2023 AND season_type = 'regular' AND player1_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player1_name ORDER BY turnovers DESC LIMIT 10
cases.summary: Counts turnover events (eventmsgtype = 5) grouped by player1 (the player charged with the turnover), excluding team turnovers where no individual player is recorded. Showing the top 10 players by turnover count for the 2023-24 regular season (the only season loaded).

cases.sql: SELECT player1_name AS player, COUNT(*) AS ft_attempts, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(homedescription, visitordescription, neutraldescription) NOT LIKE 'MISS%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ft_made, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(homedescription, visitordescription, neutraldescription) NOT LIKE 'MISS%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS ft_pct FROM nba.pbp_event WHERE season = 2023 AND season_type = 'regular' AND eventmsgtype = 3 GROUP BY player1_id, player1_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 300 ORDER BY ft_pct DESC
cases.summary: Computed free throw percentage (makes/attempts) per player from pbp_event free-throw rows (eventmsgtype=3), using the description text to identify misses, restricted to players with at least 300 attempts in the loaded 2023-24 regular season.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS attempts, SUM(shot_made_flag) AS makes, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(shot_made_flag) / COUNT(*), 1) AS fg3_pct FROM nba.shot_detail WHERE shot_type = '3PT Field Goal' AND period = 4 AND (minutes_remaining * 60 + seconds_remaining) <= 120
cases.summary: Three-point shooting percentage for shots taken in the last two minutes (game clock ≤ 2:00) of the 4th quarter across the 2023-24 regular season, computed from shot_detail (field goals only).

cases.sql: SELECT team_name, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE shot_zone_basic IN ('Left Corner 3','Right Corner 3')) AS corner_3pa, COUNT(*) AS total_3pa, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE shot_zone_basic IN ('Left Corner 3','Right Corner 3')) / COUNT(*), 1) AS corner_share_pct FROM nba.shot_detail WHERE season = 2023 AND season_type = 'regular' AND shot_type = '3PT Field Goal' GROUP BY team_name ORDER BY corner_share_pct DESC LIMIT 10
cases.summary: Ranks teams by the share of their total 3-point attempts that came from the corners (Left Corner 3 + Right Corner 3 zones) in the 2023-24 regular season, the only season loaded. Showing the top 10 teams with their corner-3 count and total 3PA as the denominator.

cases.sql:
WITH fg_points AS (
  SELECT player_id, player_name, SUM(CASE WHEN shot_type = '3PT Field Goal' THEN 3 ELSE 2 END) AS pts
  FROM nba.shot_detail
  WHERE shot_made_flag = 1
  GROUP BY player_id, player_name
),
ft_points AS (
  SELECT player1_id AS player_id, player1_name AS player_name, COUNT(*) AS pts
  FROM nba.pbp_event
  WHERE eventmsgtype = 3
    AND COALESCE(homedescription, visitordescription, neutraldescription) NOT LIKE 'MISS%'
  GROUP BY player1_id, player1_name
)
SELECT player_name, SUM(pts) AS total_points
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM fg_points
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM ft_points
) combined
GROUP BY player_name
ORDER BY total_points DESC
LIMIT 10;
cases.summary: Computes total points per player as field-goal points (2 or 3) from nba.shot_detail plus made free throws (1 point each) from nba.pbp_event, since shot_detail excludes free throws. Only the 2023-24 regular season is loaded, which is treated as 'this season'; returns the top 10 scorers.

"Best shooters" is ambiguous here — do you want overall field-goal percentage, three-point percentage, effective FG% (which weights 3s more), or a volume-adjusted leaderboard? Each ranks a different set of players, and I don't want to guess. Also note: only 2023-24 regular season data is loaded, and shot data covers field goals only (no free throws), so any efficiency metric would only reflect field goal attempts.

cases.sql:
WITH clutch_fg AS (
  SELECT sd.player_id, sd.player_name,
         CASE WHEN sd.shot_type = '3PT Field Goal' THEN 3 ELSE 2 END AS points
  FROM nba.shot_detail sd
  JOIN nba.pbp_event pe ON pe.game_id = sd.game_id AND pe.eventnum = sd.game_event_id
  WHERE sd.shot_made_flag = 1
    AND (
      (sd.period = 4 AND (sd.minutes_remaining * 60 + sd.seconds_remaining) <= 300)
      OR sd.period > 4
    )
    AND (pe.scoremargin = 'TIE' OR abs(pe.scoremargin::int) <= 5)
),
clutch_ft AS (
  SELECT pe.player1_id AS player_id, pe.player1_name AS player_name, 1 AS points
  FROM nba.pbp_event pe
  WHERE pe.eventmsgtype = 3
    AND COALESCE(pe.homedescription, pe.visitordescription, pe.neutraldescription) NOT LIKE 'MISS%'
    AND (
      (pe.period = 4 AND (split_part(pe.pctimestring, ':', 1)::int * 60 + split_part(pe.pctimestring, ':', 2)::int) <= 300)
      OR pe.period > 4
    )
    AND (pe.scoremargin = 'TIE' OR abs(pe.scoremargin::int) <= 5)
)
SELECT player_name, SUM(points) AS clutch_points
FROM (
  SELECT player_id, player_name, points FROM clutch_fg
  UNION ALL
  SELECT player_id, player_name, points FROM clutch_ft
) t
WHERE player_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY player_name
ORDER BY clutch_points DESC
LIMIT 1;
cases.summary: I defined "clutch" as scoring output during clutch time (4th quarter or overtime, 5 minutes or less remaining, score margin within 5 points or tied), summing made field goals (from shot_detail) and made free throws (from pbp_event, since free throws aren't in shot_detail) per player. This is a proxy for clutch scoring volume, not an official clutch rating -- there's no single definition, but this matches the common NBA convention for 'clutch time'.

"Improved" implies a comparison across time periods (e.g., season-over-season, or last year vs this year), but only the 2023-24 regular season is loaded in this database - there is no prior season, no playoff data, and no season-aggregate stats to compare against. I can't measure improvement without a baseline period to compare to.
This database only contains 2023-24 regular season data (season=2023, season_type='regular'). No playoff data of any season is loaded, so I can't show Jayson Tatum's 2024 playoff performance.

Only the 2023-24 regular season is loaded in this database (season = 2023, season_type = 'regular'). There is no 2019 (or any other prior season) data available, so I cannot compare LeBron James's shooting between 2019 and this season.

There is no player biographical data in this database (no height, weight, position, etc.), so players cannot be filtered by height. I can show the shot-count leaderboard overall, but not restricted to players taller than 7 feet, without that data.
This database has no awards, standings, or voting data — it only contains 2023-24 regular season play-by-play and shot detail events. It cannot tell you who won MVP.

The database has no salary or payroll data at all — it only contains play-by-play events and shot detail for the 2023-24 regular season. There's no way to determine who is highest-paid from this data.
